enabled.description: Group digested sources into cross-source episodes.

maxSourcesPerRun.description: Digested sources assigned per run, oldest first.

attachScore.description: Score at which a source joins an episode without asking the model (sum of shared-entity rarity, weighted by recency). Bystander sources need 1.5x.

reviewScore.description: Lowest score at which the model is asked whether a source continues an episode.

recencyDays.description: Time scale of the recency weight: a source this many days after an episode's last activity counts about 60% as much.

maxAdjudicationsPerRun.description: Uncertain assignments the model reviews per run (six sources per request).

dormantDays.description: Days without activity before an episode is marked dormant.

clusteringMode.description: Global constrained clustering of digested sources (Leiden/CPM over shared rare entities, threads, wikilinks). off: not run; shadow: recorded beside the model's review for comparison (graph_shadow_decisions); active: replaces the model's middle-band review and duplicate merging.

narrativeMode.description: Deterministic episode narrative (kind/stage state machine, top-entity title, extractive summary). off: model only; shadow: recorded beside the model's rewrite; active: replaces the model's rewrite (see llmNarrativePolish).

llmNarrativePolish.description: With narrativeMode active, still let the model rewrite multi-source narratives (the deterministic one is the fallback).

clusterResolution.description: CPM resolution: affinity (shared-entity rarity, time-decayed) needed per pair of sources for groups to join. Higher splits more.

clusterTauDays.description: Time scale of the clustering's temporal kernel: sources this many days apart count about 37% as much.

clusterHysteresis.description: Extra mean affinity a member must have to another episode before active clustering moves it there.

clusterMergeAffinity.description: Active clustering merges two episodes only when each member of the smaller one has, on average, at least this affinity to its closest member of the other (direct evidence, not a chain through the cluster).

maxClusterChangesPerRun.description: Most membership changes (attach, move, merge, create) active clustering makes per run.

llmModel.description: Optional chat model override for episode review and consolidation.
